justification: Test-only fix: PR #703 renamed the granny-flat cross-sell card titles from internal codenames to consumer names, but CrossSellCards.test.tsx still asserted the old codenames, breaking jest on main (2 failures). Updates the two expectations to the current rendered titles; no production code touched.

break_it.scenario: The new expectations pass vacuously against some other element containing the same text
break_it.what_happens: The test would stop guarding the cross-sell card rendering entirely
break_it.how: the titles asserted are the exact card heading strings in app/reports/granny-flat/page.tsx CrossSellCards default fail branch; the sibling link-href test in the same describe block still pins the threat-radar destination
break_it.repro: npx jest --testPathPattern=CrossSellCards -> 7/7 pass; grep 'Development Monitoring' app/reports/granny-flat/page.tsx

post_merge.manual_verify: No — jest suite is the verification; failures reproduced on main before the fix and pass after it.
